settings.title: Settings
settings.revokeText: Without this consent the chat becomes unavailable until you accept it again. Withdrawing does not delete your data; data deletion is a separate request.
settings.revokeDataHint: To delete your data, see the <anchor>Your data</anchor> section.

data.deleteExportFirst: If you want to keep a copy, download your data first.

safety.title: You are not alone
safety.text: It sounds like you might be going through something really hard. You deserve support, and talking to someone can help. These services are free and confidential:

lines.emotionalCrisis: helpline for adults in emotional crisis (Poland)
lines.lifelineUkraine: Lifeline Ukraine, suicide prevention and mental health support
lines.emergency: emergency number if your life or someone else’s is in danger
